title: Guide: urlSync
body:
There should be a dedicated section in the guide about url sync.

It should explains:
- [ ] what is the default behavior
- [ ] how to only set some attributes (trackedParameters)
- [ ] how to rename attributes
- [ ] how to add and sync more parameters (like custom_param=avalue)
- [x] what is is_v?
- [ ] when do you need to use the hash method (< IE9)
- [ ] Document default aliases
